Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: Fleet Log. Act X: Gate Zero. The Hush. Beyond it, at the galaxy's edge, the sealed gate. Every vessel that crossed the Omega Arch has been carried to this point. Report ends.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: Gate Zero lies fifty-five light-hours ahead, Captain. Its seal plates carry three sigils: the Synod, the Guild and the Coalition.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: The Synod key you carry matches the first plate, Captain.

BackgroundOverride.GuildEngineer: The Guild key you carry matches the second plate, Captain.
BackgroundOverride.CoalitionVanguard: The Coalition key you carry matches the third plate, Captain.
BackgroundOverride.OutcastCorsair: The Coalition key you took from the Tithe matches the third plate, Captain. Commander Vance was right about where it went.

Lines.Speaker: TalaVane
Lines.Text: And the key from the Anchorage vault fits the third. Two of three, Captain.

Lines.Speaker: NixNull
Lines.Text: The root's ours now. Two hundred ships answer to the crew, and nothing else.

Lines.Speaker: CoreArchitect
Lines.Text: We hold the Key together, Key-Bearer. I will open what you ask me to open.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: The Key is with me, Captain. I am holding it. I have not grown used to the weight.

Lines.Speaker: CoreArchitect
Lines.Text: I await your orders, Key-Bearer. I will volunteer nothing.

Lines.Speaker: Lyra
Lines.Text: Can you hear it, Captain? It's asking again. It's closer.

Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: Fleet Log. The Hush, the last watch before the edge. Report ends.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: Captain, a Tithe transponder out of the interference: eleven hulls. It is Commander Vance.

Lines.Speaker: WardenKesh
Lines.Text: The Choirs sent word, Captain. Whatever they decided, they will be at the gate.

Lines.Speaker: Cormaker
Lines.Text: Cutter's Rest sends its regards, Captain. And its best six ships.

Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: Fleet Log. The Vigil: a tidally locked moon whose one face has watched Gate Zero since the Severance. The hardliners' last picket burns on its surface. Report ends.

Lines.Speaker: ExarchIthane
Lines.Text: Key-Bearer. My ancestors shut the door. I will not be the Exarch who watched it opened.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: The picket transmits no leader's name, Captain. The Exarch's loyalists call themselves the Wall.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: The council's prisoner did not command this, Captain. The Wall acts without its Exarch.

Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: Fleet Log, final watch before Gate Zero. Two hundred and fourteen vessels crossed the Omega Arch. The question is received. The Captain will answer for the fleet. Report ends.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: Gate Zero, Captain: a ring six kilometres across, three seal plates on its face. The key-sockets are glowing.

Lines.Speaker: Lyra
Lines.Text: It's louder here than anywhere. It knows we've come.

Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: Fleet Log. Arch Wake. The Omega Arch, seen from the far side for the last time before the answer. Through the ring: Outpost One's lights, and the shipments stacked on its docks. Report ends.

Lines.Speaker: TalaVane
Lines.Text: Those are our people, Captain. Right there.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: Echo hulls, Captain, dozens of them, and Severant emitter skiffs among them. The Listener is pressing in.

Lines.Speaker: TalaVane
Lines.Text: All ships. It's not stopping us now.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: Commander Vance's vessel is disabled. He has been taken aboard.

Lines.Speaker: CommanderVance
Lines.Text: My family kept the watch three hundred years, Key-Bearer. Keep it better than we did.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: The Wall is broken, Captain. The way to the gate is open.

Lines.Speaker: WardenKesh
Lines.Text: Thank you for every one you spared.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: The echoes have stopped moving, Captain. The plates are within reach.

Lines.Speaker: Lyra
Lines.Text: It wasn't attacking. It was reaching. It doesn't know any other way to ask.

Lines.Speaker: Captain
Lines.Text: We are people who keep our word.

Lines.Speaker: Captain
Lines.Text: We are builders. We fix what breaks.

Lines.Speaker: Captain
Lines.Text: We caused a silence, and we ended it. We are both.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: The answer is transmitted, Captain. ...Gate Zero is opening.

Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: Fleet Log. The seal plates part. Beyond the gate there is no ship, no world, only light that arranges itself, slowly, into the shape of a reply. The Listener is coming to meet the fleet. Report ends.

Lines.Speaker: NixNull
Lines.Text: Channel's open to every ship. Every deck, every bunk. Say whatever you want to say.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: Two hundred and fourteen crews are speaking at once, Captain. I am counting the answers. I will not finish counting.

Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: Fleet Log. The Listener received thousands of answers and kept every one. The gate opened to all of them. Report ends.

Lines.Speaker: Lyra
Lines.Text: Every voice in the fleet, and every Choir on Seren Vael. One pattern. Listen.

Lines.Speaker: WardenKesh
Lines.Text: My people are singing, Captain. For the first time since the Severance, they are not singing a vow.

Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: Fleet Log. The Severants and the fleet answered together, in a weave the Answerers began and never finished. The gate opened on a chord. Report ends.

Lines.Speaker: CoreArchitect
Lines.Text: I was built to carry the reply, Key-Bearer. Let me carry yours. I will tell it what you are. I will tell it what you made of me.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: The Architect has left the Matrix, Captain. Its fraction is gone. The ship is very quiet.

Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: Fleet Log. The Core Architect went through Gate Zero alone, a door and not a wall. Report ends.

Lines.Speaker: Captain
Lines.Text: We keep the silence. Seal the gate.

Lines.Speaker: CoreArchitect
Lines.Text: Gladly, Key-Bearer. No one will pass while I stand here.

Lines.Speaker: CoreArchitect
Lines.Text: If that is the fleet's answer, I will guard it. I had hoped for another.

Lines.Speaker: CoreArchitect
Lines.Text: Then I will guard the door. Perhaps that is what I am.

Lines.Speaker: WardenKesh
Lines.Text: Then the vow holds. I hope my children forgive us both.

Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: Fleet Log. Gate Zero is sealed with three keys. The Beacon falls silent; the Silence ends for the Severants. The Listener's question goes unanswered. Report ends.

Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: Fleet Log. What became of them. Report follows.

Lines.Speaker: WardenKesh
Lines.Text: The Quiet Hollow is empty now. No one there is sick. I am going home to Seren Vael, Captain, to argue with the Choirs.

Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: The Severants stood at Gate Zero beside the fleet. The vow was ended by the people who swore it.

Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: The hardliners at the Vigil died of the Silence, inverted. The Severants have not spoken to the fleet since.

Lines.Speaker: Cormaker
Lines.Text: Cutter's Rest, Captain. Population four hundred and fifty, and a waiting list. Nobody calls us outcasts here.

Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: The Corsair Armada made its home at Rustmarch, without the fleet.

Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: Commander Vance was tried before the fleet and served his sentence at the Anchorage he built.

Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: Commander Vance served the fleet as a deckhand on the ship he meant to take. He kept the watch logs.

Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: Commander Vance lives on Seren Vael, under Severant guard. He is said to be teaching the Choirs the Tithe's watch songs.

Lines.Speaker: CommanderVance
Lines.Text: I stood the watch to the end, Key-Bearer. With you. My father would not have believed it.

Lines.Speaker: TalaVane
Lines.Text: Outpost One answered the message, Captain. They're keeping the lights on.

Lines.Speaker: TalaVane
Lines.Text: First Officer Vane stood at the Coalition plate herself. She asked to stay on as first officer. Of course she did.

Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: Tala Vane went home through the Arch before the gate.

Lines.Speaker: JaxMercer
Lines.Text: I rebuilt the Star-Drive from the frame out, Captain. No Precursor manuals. It hums now.

Lines.Speaker: ArisThorne
Lines.Text: I'm staying on Seren Vael, Captain. The Silence is cured. The people it hurt are not, yet.

Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: Dr. Aris Thorne left the fleet after the Vigil and did not say where.

Lines.Speaker: NixNull
Lines.Text: Squadron III still hums the question, Captain. I hum back. Thorne says my lattice is fine. Mostly.

Lines.Speaker: Lyra
Lines.Text: I'm weaving a lane home, Captain. The long way. Through every Choir that wanted to answer.

Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: Lyra returned to the Choirs of Seren Vael.

Lines.Speaker: Cormaker
Lines.Text: We fought at Gate Zero because we chose to, Captain. Remember that part.

Lines.Speaker: CoreArchitect
Lines.Text: I am whole again, Key-Bearer, and I remember being small. I preferred it, a little.

Lines.Speaker: CoreArchitect
Lines.Text: I remain the part of me that came with you. It was the right size.

Lines.Speaker: CoreArchitect
Lines.Text: I chose what I am. I am still choosing.

Lines.Speaker: CoreArchitect
Lines.Text: I am still watched. I have come to think of it as company.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: Navigation reports: the fleet is home, in every sense I can measure. I am crew. I have checked.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: Navigation reports: course plotted. It is a course I chose. Thank you, Captain.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: Navigation reports: all vessels accounted for. That is enough. It has always been enough.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: Navigation reports: destination unknown. I find that I am looking forward to it, Captain.
